require 'socket'
require 'openssl'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'

module ChatCrypto
  BLOCK_SIZE = 16
  MAX_CHUNK_SIZE = 4096

  def self.derive_key(password, salt)
    OpenSSL::KDF.pbkdf2_hmac(password, salt: salt, iterations: 10000, length: 32, hash: "sha256")
  end

  def self.encrypt_message(plaintext, key)
    cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher::AES256.new(:CBC)
    cipher.encrypt
    iv = cipher.random_iv
    cipher.key = key
    encrypted = cipher.update(plaintext) + cipher.final
    { iv: iv.unpack1('H*'), data: encrypted.unpack1('H*') }
  end

  def self.decrypt_message(encrypted_hex, iv_hex, key)
    cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher::AES256.new(:CBC)
    cipher.decrypt
    cipher.iv = [iv_hex].pack('H*')
    cipher.key = key
    cipher.update([encrypted_hex].pack('H*')) + cipher.final
  end
end

class MessageBuffer
  HEADER_SIZE = 8
  LENGTH_FIELD_OFFSET = 4
  MAX_MESSAGES = 1000

  def initialize
    @buffer = []
    @sequence_counter = 0
    @total_bytes_stored = 0
  end

  def compute_storage_allocation(msg_length, header_metadata)
    # header_metadata contains priority (0-255) and flags
    priority = header_metadata[:priority] & 0xFF
    flags = header_metadata[:flags] & 0xFFFF

    # Calculate padded size: message + padding to block boundary
    padding_needed = ChatCrypto::BLOCK_SIZE - (msg_length % ChatCrypto::BLOCK_SIZE)
    padded_length = msg_length + padding_needed

    # Apply priority-based reservation: higher priority gets more buffer space
    # Reserved space = padded_length + (256 - priority) overhead bytes
    overhead = 256 - priority
    total_allocation = padded_length + overhead

    # Subtract header size that's already accounted for in the frame
    # This computes available payload capacity
    available_capacity = total_allocation - HEADER_SIZE
    available_capacity
  end

  def store_encrypted(encrypted_payload, header_metadata)
    return false if @buffer.length >= MAX_MESSAGES

    msg_length = encrypted_payload[:data].length / 2  # hex string to byte count
    allocation = compute_storage_allocation(msg_length, header_metadata)

    # Use allocation as index into chunked storage ring
    chunk_index = allocation % ChatCrypto::MAX_CHUNK_SIZE

    @sequence_counter += 1
    @total_bytes_stored += allocation

    entry = {
      seq: @sequence_counter,
      payload: encrypted_payload,
      chunk_idx: chunk_index,
      alloc_size: allocation,
      timestamp: Time.now.to_i
    }

    @buffer.push(entry)
    true
  end

  def retrieve_range(start_seq, count)
    # Validate range using allocation arithmetic
    end_seq = start_seq + count
    results = @buffer.select { |e| e[:seq] >= start_seq && e[:seq] < end_seq }

    # Compute total retrieval cost
    total_cost = results.sum { |e| e[:alloc_size] }

    # Safety check: if total retrieval exceeds buffer capacity, truncate
    if total_cost > MAX_MESSAGES * ChatCrypto::MAX_CHUNK_SIZE
      results = results.first(10)
    end

    results
  end

  def buffer_utilization
    @total_bytes_stored
  end
end

class ChatServer
  def initialize(port, password)
    @port = port
    @salt = SecureRandom.random_bytes(16)
    @key = ChatCrypto.derive_key(password, @salt)
    @clients = []
    @message_store = MessageBuffer.new
  end

  def handle_client(client_socket)
    loop do
      raw = client_socket.gets
      break if raw.nil?

      begin
        frame = JSON.parse(raw.strip, symbolize_names: true)
        process_frame(frame, client_socket)
      rescue JSON::ParserError => e
        client_socket.puts({ error: "invalid frame" }.to_json)
      end
    end
  rescue IOError, Errno::ECONNRESET
    @clients.delete(client_socket)
  end

  def process_frame(frame, sender)
    case frame[:type]
    when "message"
      handle_message(frame, sender)
    when "history"
      handle_history(frame, sender)
    when "status"
      sender.puts({ type: "status", utilization: @message_store.buffer_utilization }.to_json)
    end
  end

  def handle_message(frame, sender)
    content = frame[:content].to_s
    priority = (frame[:priority] || 128).to_i
    flags = (frame[:flags] || 0).to_i

    encrypted = ChatCrypto.encrypt_message(content, @key)
    metadata = { priority: priority, flags: flags }

    stored = @message_store.store_encrypted(encrypted, metadata)

    if stored
      broadcast(encrypted, sender)
      sender.puts({ type: "ack", status: "delivered" }.to_json)
    else
      sender.puts({ type: "ack", status: "buffer_full" }.to_json)
    end
  end

  def handle_history(frame, sender)
    start = (frame[:start_seq] || 1).to_i
    count = (frame[:count] || 10).to_i
    count = [count, 50].min  # cap at 50

    results = @message_store.retrieve_range(start, count)
    sender.puts({ type: "history", messages: results.map { |r| r[:payload] } }.to_json)
  end

  def broadcast(encrypted, sender)
    @clients.each do |client|
      next if client == sender
      client.puts({ type: "message", payload: encrypted }.to_json) rescue nil
    end
  end

  def start
    server = TCPServer.new('127.0.0.1', @port)
    puts "Chat server listening on port #{@port}"

    loop do
      client = server.accept
      @clients << client
      Thread.new { handle_client(client) }
    end
  end
end

if __FILE__ == $0
  password = ENV['CHAT_PASSWORD'] || SecureRandom.hex(16)
  ChatServer.new(9443, password).start
end
